channel.title: News in the Grove - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from News in the Grove (newsinthegrove.com)

item.title: More than 2 million seedlings planted this season in Oregon's state forests
item.description: A mild winter helped the Oregon Department of Forestry plant roughly 2 million seedlings ahead of schedule, including in the Tillamook State Forest.

item.title: Drivers have two weeks to remove studded tires before April 1 deadline
item.description: Oregon drivers have two weeks to remove studded tires before the April 1 deadline or face a $165 fine.

item.title: Pacific University's Ben Christianson holds tenor recital at Taylor-Meade
item.description: Pacific University junior Ben Christianson performed 10 pieces spanning three centuries at Pacific University’s Taylor-Meade Performing Arts Center.

item.title: Fern Hill Road is open again
item.description: Fern Hill Road between Taylor Way and Geiger Road has reopened after the latest round of flooding closed the popular commuter route last week.

item.title: This Week in Forest Grove — Mar. 19–24
item.description: Aloha Friday open mic and magic show at Zesti, Country Night at Bullets, Spring Breakfast at FGSCC, General Trivia at Pelagic Brewing, and 35 more events this week.

item.title: Column | 1976 in Forest Grove: Ralph Brown runs for office, literally
item.description: In 1976, Ralph Brown planned to jog 14.5 miles from Aloha to the Forest Grove High School to campaign for a District 4 seat. This and more in the news of the 1970s!

item.title: Forest Grove News: Fern Hill Road reopens, new campground, and more | March 20, 2026
item.description: This week: Fern Hill Road is open again, Pacific University's Ben Christianson holds tenor recital at Taylor-Meade, a new campground takes shape and more.

item.title: Forest Grove police searching for missing 70-year-old man
item.description: Edward Bouno, 70, was last seen Saturday afternoon on David Hill Road near Thatcher Park.

item.title: ODF sends crews to North Carolina to fight wildfires
item.description: The Oregon Department of Forestry deployed 21 firefighters and an agency representative to North Carolina over the weekend to help fight wildfires.

item.title: Mini pancake and juice cart opens in downtown Forest Grove
item.description: Mina's Mini Pancakes & Antojitos opened Tuesday behind Picasso's Art & Antiques at the corner of Ash and Pacific Avenue.
